stem:
Nidhi studies a pond with the feeding links pond plants → small fish → kingfisher. Pollution kills many pond plants.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: Less oxygen is available in the water when many pond plants die.
Small fish may decline because food and oxygen linked to the plants become scarce.
Only the pond plants are affected; small fish and kingfishers stay the same.

teacher.key_rationale: Losing pond plants reduces oxygen and food, so small fish can decline and the change spreads through the feeding links. Claiming only plants are affected ignores those connected effects.
